name: /refine-backlog
description: Process backlog items: promote to TODO, defer, or delete

steps.context: Read .exocortex/control/BACKLOG.md and .exocortex/TODO.md. Show summary of both. For each backlog item one at a time, ask: (A) Promote to TODO — then ask for executable task title + scope, (B) Not yet — ask what's needed, update backlog notes, (C) Defer — leave as-is, (D) Delete. Also check TODO for completed [x] items, ask to remove each.

steps.action: Prepare the exact guarded mutation request
steps.context: Show the complete proposed project-local diff. If the user wants it recorded, identify exact paths, current work-item revision, executor, and content for a one-time capability. Do not write until the registered guarded executor accepts it.
